name: codex-bridge-chatgpt
description: Persistent ChatGPT planning with local Codex execution, read-only MCP context tools, and crash-safe state coordination.

interface.shortDescription: Persistent Chat context with local Codex execution.
interface.longDescription: A persistent handoff for Mac and Windows ChatGPT desktop users. Codex reuses one ordinary ChatGPT Chat for planning, writing, review, and reasoning, synchronizes bounded deltas and locally verified receipts, and retains local authority over computer actions, edits, and tests. Direct app chat coordination is preferred; visible web automation remains an explicitly consented fallback.
defaultPrompt: Use $codex-bridge-chatgpt to keep this task synchronized with one ordinary ChatGPT Chat.
Use $codex-bridge-chatgpt to let ChatGPT plan and draft while Codex executes and verifies.
Use $codex-bridge-chatgpt to resume the persistent Chat context and continue local work.
